title.es: Un plan mejor para recoger reciclaje

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A2 con un texto original sobre recycling.
intro.en: Practise A2 English reading with an original text about recycling.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: The residents of Brookfield used to put recycling bags outside on different days, and the collection team often missed some streets. Last month, the council tested a clearer plan. Each street received a colour and a collection day. Blue streets put paper and cardboard outside on Monday, while green streets put glass and metal outside on Tuesday. A reminder card explained what could not go in the bags. After four weeks, fewer bags contained the wrong materials, but some residents said the colour system was confusing at night. The council will add brighter signs before deciding whether to keep the plan. For planning purposes, readers should check the time, the conditions, and the person responsible. These details may change, so the safest choice is to confirm them before taking the next step. The message gives guidance, but people still need to make a practical decision.
